### Engine bugs (deliberately not yet implemented)

- BUG: flex item automatic minimum size from intrinsic aspect-ratio not implemented. With intrinsic sizes injected, the square `hero` <img> (flex: 0 0 61.8%, height 800) should clamp its used width UP to its aspect-ratio auto-min (800px) per CSS Flexbox §4.5; engine keeps it near the 61.8% basis, so `remainder` gets width 640 vs Chrome 392. See rendering-bugs/2026-06-20-flex-aspect-ratio-auto-min-size.md (fixture:     run_fixture_test_with_intrinsic_sizes()
- BUG: overflow:hidden clips child layout dimensions instead of only visual clipping (fixture: bg-image-overflow-hidden)
- BUG: margin collapse not implemented — inner margin-top (100px) should collapse through outer (no border/padding/BFC), placing outer at y=100 and inner at y=100 per Chrome. Engine returns outer.y=0. (fixture: clip-path-polygon-margin-collapse)
